contradiction_resolution: No claim-level contradiction (contradicts_claim_ids is empty; compatible with CONJ-0001, THM-0001 through THM-0007, OBS-0001, RED-0001). However, the finding contains a mathematical imprecision: the isomorphism Gr^W_m H^m_c(X) isomorphic to ker(H^m(Y) -> H^m(D)) uses D = boundary space, whereas standard MHS theory (Deligne weight spectral sequence for compactly supported cohomology; CLP Eq. 6.1 plus Poincare duality) yields Gr^W_m H^m_c(X) isomorphic to ker(H^m(Y) -> H^m(D-tilde)) where D-tilde is the normalization (disjoint union of smooth components). For a normal crossings divisor D with multiple components, the Mayer-Vietoris spectral sequence can make ker(H^m(Y) -> H^m(D)) strictly contained in ker(H^m(Y) -> H^m(D-tilde)), so the stated isomorphism is not a direct consequence of localization plus Deligne weight bounds alone. The pure polarizable HS assertion is correct (kernel of MHS morphism from pure HS is pure). Compatible with FND-0031 (depth-one Gysin at the pure corner), FND-0033 (semisimplicity), and FND-0048 (unresolved identification of the pure piece). The specific (6,6,16) case requires additional control of the boundary MV spectral sequence at H^16 to establish whether the D-versus-D-tilde gap vanishes. The finding should remain candidate pending either (a) correction to use D-tilde, or (b) proof that ker(H^16(Mbar_6,6) -> H^16(D)) = ker(H^16(Mbar_6,6) -> H^16(D-tilde)) for the moduli boundary.

scope.cases: smooth open X in smooth proper DM stack Y with closed NCD complement D; specific claim at (g,n,m)=(6,6,16)
scope.precise_scope_note: The general statement requires D replaced by its normalization D-tilde (disjoint union of smooth boundary components) for the isomorphism to follow from standard MHS machinery. For (6,6,16), d=21, the correct statement from CLP Eq. 6.1 plus Poincare duality gives Gr^W_16 H^16_c(M_6,6) isomorphic to ker(H^16(Mbar_6,6) -> H^16(D-tilde)) where D-tilde is the normalization of the boundary, not ker(H^16(Mbar_6,6) -> H^16(D)) as stated.

source_records.evidence_note: SRC-0002 Eq. 6.1 gives the right-exact boundary sequence H^{k-2}(D-tilde)(-1) -> H^k(Mbar) -> W_k H^k(M) -> 0, which at k=26 yields Gr^W_26 H^26(M_6,6) as cokernel of the Gysin map from the normalized boundary. Via Poincare duality on M (dim 21), this dualizes to Gr^W_16 H^16_c(M_6,6) = ker(restriction: H^16(Mbar_6,6) -> H^16(D-tilde)), using the normalization D-tilde, not the boundary space D itself.

SRC-0001 (Payne survey) confirms degree 16 as open and records the pure Hodge structure conventions for smooth proper DM stacks. The top-weight piece of compactly supported cohomology Gr^W_m H^m_c is computed by the weight spectral sequence whose E_1 page involves the normalization of the NCD, not the boundary space itself.
